//name: Named after sottracker.fr, not after the game. 'Sea of Thieves' is Rare's mark, and a store — Microsoft's above all — reads a trademark in the NAME as a claim of affiliation. Describing what the tool does is fine; being called it is not.
name: SotTracker
description: Unofficial tracker for Sea of Thieves. Syncs your gold, Hourglass rank and reputation to sottracker.fr.
//host_permissions: Exactly what a sync touches: the game site to read stats, the tracker to publish them, localhost for development. Self-hosting a tracker elsewhere means adding that origin here.
//optional_permissions: Optional on purpose: a new REQUIRED permission makes browsers hold the update back until the user accepts it, and the people this release is for are precisely those who never open the extension. The badge needs no permission and ships to everyone; reminders are opt-in from the popup.
author: Vyros__
